spec_basis_slices_2_3.STU-VEC-010: Each shape is a live StudioVectorPath/StudioVectorNetwork whose defining parameters remain editable until the operator or model explicitly expands it to raw geometry
spec_basis_slices_2_3.STU-VEC-127: Rectangle width/height 0.0..16348.0 pt; Polygon side_count NORMATIVE hard 3..100 (soft 3..20); inset_percentage 0..100; Star point_count 3..50; Star outer radius is the object's own size
spec_basis_slices_2_3.STU-VEC-066: the applied radius is min(requested_radius, shorter_incident_edge / 2) evaluated per corner, and the clamped value MUST be reported back to the caller
spec_basis_slices_2_3.STU-VEC-112: corner.none none / round 'rounded corner' / round_inverted 'inverse rounded corner' / inset 'inset corner' / bevel 'bevel corner' / fancy 'fancy corner'
spec_basis_slices_2_3.STU-VEC-130: Studio MUST carry all thirteen with these stable identifiers and MUST use the captured token as the wire value (divideCommand: Split all overlaps into separate closed regions; trimCommand; mergeCommand; cropCommand: Clip artwork to the topmost region)
spec_basis_slices_2_3.STU-VEC-012: ONE unified geometry-operation set that subsumes every source suite's boolean/pathfinder/geometry command family
spec_basis_slices_2_3.STU-VEC-006: offset path (numeric inset/outset copy with join-style handling of corners) ... outline stroke (convert a stroked path to filled geometry)

spec_basis.STU-VEC-003: dragging a straight segment MUST convert it to a curve by synthesizing handles on its endpoints without destroying adjacent geometry (bend_segment)
spec_basis.STU-VEC-109: handle_mirroring.none NONE / angle ANGLE / angle_and_length ANGLE_AND_LENGTH; point type smooth = 1, corner = 2 is a DERIVED read-only projection
spec_basis.STU-VEC-116: anchor_selection none 1, anchor 2, in_handle 3, out_handle 4, both_handles 5
spec_basis.STU-VEC-043: Studio MUST provide a reverse-direction command
spec_basis.STU-VEC-048: scissors splits a path at a parametric point on a segment into two open endpoints sharing a coincident position
spec_basis.STU-VEC-133: path index out of bounds; point index out of bounds; cannot join path points ... Each MUST be individually distinguishable by a model from its typed error code
